steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring a traffic-light auction.
Configure the auction's traffic-light conditions with explicit lower and upper bounds.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendors to bid on.
Complete the pricing sheet so the auction can be published.
Invite two vendors so every participant can submit a bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Have the first vendor submit a price below the configured range.
Confirm the first vendor's submission was accepted.
Have the second vendor submit a price above the configured range.
Confirm the second vendor's submission was accepted.
Open the buyer's auction Responses view, the subject under test.
Verify that all invited vendors have submitted responses before checking their traffic-light status.

args.goal: On the buyer's auction Responses view, inspect every submitted vendor response and verify that each displayed traffic-light colour matches the configured lower and upper conditions for that vendor's submitted price or rank; stop when all vendor colours have been checked.

steps.note: Perform the colour-to-condition comparison on the response cards, which has no dedicated domain assertion.
Assert that the final screen remains the buyer's Responses view.
